protocol.claim: exclusive durable local claim keyed to request hash
protocol.receipt: custodian-signed score/model digest and request hash, fsynced before rename
protocol.recovery: matching and authenticated existing receipt may be redelivered; no receipt freezes claim
protocol.tampering: invalid signature or claim mismatch freezes or rejects

expected_cases: crash immediately after durable claim frozen
crash immediately after durable receipt redelivered
limitations: Same OS user can access test keys; not a deployed independent custodian
Local filesystem durability assumptions are system-dependent
No authenticated remote timestamp or immutable independent witness
Crash after claiming but before output cannot safely recover the score
next: H069 multi-witness receipt anchoring and durable ledger verification
